name: gimmeclip
description: Download, clip, caption and transcribe public videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Twitch and more; follow YouTube channels and clip their new videos.

interface.longDescription: Turn public video links into files, watch links, captioned vertical clips and timestamped transcripts. Skills find and clip a video's best moment, download a video, part, MP3 or GIF, write notes from a transcript, and follow YouTube channels so new videos land in an inbox with moments to clip. Public videos only; anonymous use has daily limits, and an optional GIMMECLIP_API_KEY gives your account's own.
defaultPrompt: Make a vertical captioned clip of the best moment in this video.
Transcribe this TikTok and give me the key points with timestamps.
Check my gimmeclip inbox and suggest clips from new videos.
